name: Sacky
summary:
Welcome to a whole new kind of tag experience — where you’re not just another player… you’re a Sack.

Jump into a fun social world built for hanging out, exploring, and fast-paced tag gameplay. Whether you’re chilling with friends or chasing them down in intense fire tag rounds, there’s always something happening.

Play as a customizable Sack character and express your style with cosmetics you can unlock and buy. Join friends instantly using room codes and jump straight into the action.
